The Authority further decides that overall UCC ecosystem be developed in such a manner that regulations and code(s) of practice may be enforced. Access Provider(s) may authorise one or more system operator(s), as deemed fit, to provide the DLT solution to all entities, to have effective control over UCC and to keep data secure and safe. Types of DLT networks are discussed in Para 9 and accordingly recommended networks may be implemented. 3.3.28 Regulatory Sandbox: In view of multiple DLT system operators, varieties of complementing technologies, number of probable solution providers and constantly evolving requirements, a test environment may be established (as required) where new functions and processes can be tested, or existing functions or processes can be refined. This test environment may also provide possibilities to explore new ways and means to meet regulatory requirements or new service offerings.
